properties.location: Baker's Place / Kerr Street corridor, Stockbridge, Edinburgh, Scotland

properties.bedrock: Carboniferous Lower Oil-Shale Sandstone / Craigleith and Hailes sandstone formations, interbedded with siltstone and shale
properties.superficial_deposits: Glacial till overlain by Quaternary alluvial gravels and silt associated with the Water of Leith river incised valley
properties.soil_profile: Urban disturbed brown earths and compacted aggregate fill over river terrace gravels
properties.hydrology: Water of Leith riparian drainage system traversing immediately north, shallow perched groundwater table

properties.urban_morphology: Georgian / Early 19th-century New Town northern fringe urban tenement block and church focal terminus

structures.name: St Stephen's Church (background vista terminus / spired landmark)
structures.materials: Craigleith ashlar sandstone, leaded and pitched slate spire, clock tower, classical Renaissance/Baroque details

structures.name: North West Circus Place / Kerr Street Tenement Terraces (curving street flank left/right)
structures.materials: Blonde ashlar sandstone, rusticated ground floors, cast-iron railings, timber sash windows, pitched Scotch slate roofing

structures.name: Baker's Place Commercial / Residential Row
structures.materials: Ashlar sandstone facades, painted timber shopfronts, lead flashing, chimney stacks with clay pots

properties.paving_and_ground: Macadam roadway with Scottish whinstone kerbstones and historic Caithness flagstone pedestrian sidewalks

properties.vegetation: Mature urban deciduous canopy including Acer pseudoplatanus (Sycamore) and Tilia cordata (Lime), with river valley riparian shrubs and damp moss colonization along northern masonry joints
properties.foliage_density: Moderate urban street trees and riparian edge foliage

properties.lighting_condition: Overcast northern maritime daylight with diffused silver-grey sky illumination (~5800K), soft omnidirectional ambient shadowing, and slight moisture sheen on sandstone facades and Caithness flagstones
